name: saturn-dev
description: Development tooling only (commit checks, Markdown/JSON formatting). Saturn itself is Rust: see Cargo.toml.

scripts.health: pnpm run fmt:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run deps
scripts.dev: cargo build -p saturn && sh scripts/sign-local.sh target/debug/saturn && target/debug/saturn
scripts.gallery: cargo build -p saturn && sh scripts/sign-local.sh target/debug/saturn && SATURN_GALLERY=1 target/debug/saturn
